title: Identity Lockup Sequence
description: A portrait-led series establishing one artist face, styling baseline, and press-ready visual grammar before extending it into adjacent campaign looks.
creative_direction: Image 01 defines the exact artist reference model and a believable brand-kit grammar of portrait photography, abstract emblem marks, and empty layout zones. Images 02-04 preserve the exact same face, hair base, and body proportions while rotating setting, lighting, and campaign surface mood.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-press-portrait first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-monochrome-rooftop, 03-rehearsal-chair-kit, 04-gel-light-profile. Queue may run 02-monochrome-rooftop, 03-rehearsal-chair-kit, 04-gel-light-profile concurrently after 01-reference-press-portrait is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
